title: 介绍 Starbucks Chennai 科技中心的选址与协作安排
topic: 从星巴克员工信学习如何解释新办公室选址、团队归属和招聘安排。

source.title: Starbucks Technology to open new hub in Chennai, India
source.readingTitle: A new technology hub in Chennai
source.type: 发给 Starbucks Technology 团队的全员信
paragraphs: The selection of Chennai was informed by several factors, including access to a deep pool of technology talent, a reputation for strong talent retention, the ability to support our long-term business needs and alignment with the ways our teams work across Seattle, Nashville, London and Hong Kong. As we move forward, this office will become part of our broader Technology footprint, not a separate or standalone team.
The intent is to strengthen how we deliver for Starbucks partners, coffeehouses and customers by building teams that are connected across sites and focused on shared priorities.

We are still in the early stages of this work. Over the coming months, we will begin planning for local hiring, office readiness and the operating rhythms needed to support the new hub. We expect recruiting to begin in Q1, with additional details to come as plans are finalized.
translations: 选择 Chennai 综合考虑了多项因素，包括当地充足的技术人才、较高的人才留任率、长期业务需求，以及与西雅图、纳什维尔、伦敦和香港团队协作方式的契合度。随着工作推进，这个办公室将成为更大范围技术组织的一部分，而非独立团队。
此举旨在建立跨地点协作、聚焦共同重点的团队，进一步提升我们服务星巴克员工、门店和顾客的能力。
目前工作仍处于早期阶段。接下来几个月，我们会开始规划本地招聘、办公室准备和支持新中心所需的协作节奏。招聘预计在第一季度启动，计划敲定后会公布更多细节。
fullTextParagraphs: Earlier this year, I shared that Starbucks Technology was taking the next step in our multi-site strategy by planning for a new Technology Hub in India. At the time, we were still evaluating the location and committed to sharing more once that decision was finalized.
Today, I’m pleased to share that we have selected Chennai, India as the location for this office.

This is an important milestone in how we continue to build a more flexible and globally connected Technology organization. Our teams already work closely with technology vendors in India and other countries. Establishing a Starbucks Technology hub in India gives us the opportunity to build a more partner-centric organization which will be created by bringing capability inside Starbucks over time and creating stronger connections to the work, priorities and culture of our business.

The selection of Chennai was informed by several factors, including access to a deep pool of technology talent, a reputation for strong talent retention, the ability to support our long-term business needs and alignment with the ways our teams work across Seattle, Nashville, London and Hong Kong. As we move forward, this office will become part of our broader Technology footprint, not a separate or standalone team.
The intent is to strengthen how we deliver for Starbucks partners, coffeehouses and customers by building teams that are connected across sites and focused on shared priorities.

We are still in the early stages of this work. Over the coming months, we will begin planning for local hiring, office readiness and the operating rhythms needed to support the new hub. We expect recruiting to begin in Q1, with additional details to come as plans are finalized.

I recognize this is a meaningful change in how we organize and grow our Technology teams. A multi-site model requires clarity, intentional connection and strong leadership across locations. We will continue to communicate openly as this work progresses and make sure teams understand what is changing, what is not changing and how this supports our broader Technology strategy.
Thank you for your continued focus and partnership.
verifiedFacts: Starbucks 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日发布了新建印度技术中心的员工沟通。
邮件称选址考虑了人才、留任、长期业务需求和跨地区协作。
邮件称招聘预计在第一季度启动，后续细节待计划确定后更新。

notes.explain: be informed by 用于介绍一项决定背后的依据，不只是列出结果。
notes.example: The site decision was informed by local talent, customer needs, and how our teams work.

notes.phrase: become part of our broader Technology footprint
notes.meaning: 成为更大团队或组织的一部分
notes.explain: broader 表示范围更广；这句话适合说明新团队的组织归属。
notes.example: The new office will become part of our broader operations network.

notes.phrase: additional details to come as plans are finalized
notes.meaning: 计划确定后再公布更多细节
notes.explain: details to come 是简洁的后续更新表达，常用于暂未敲定的安排。
notes.example: Recruiting details will follow as the plans are finalized.

scenario.title: 虚构练习：在新城市开设客户支持中心
english: The company plans to open a support center in Kuala Lumpur.
The city has a strong talent pool, and the site will work with teams in London and Sydney.
Tell employees why the location was chosen, how the new site fits the organization, and when hiring details will follow.

当地人才资源充足，新中心会与伦敦和悉尼的团队协作。
向员工说明选址原因、新团队的组织归属，以及招聘细节何时公布。

firstAttempt.prompt: 根据 Starbucks 2026 年 9 月关于 Chennai 科技中心的公告，写三句话：说明选址依据、新中心如何融入现有组织，以及招聘信息何时更新。
firstAttempt.sample: Starbucks selected Chennai after considering local technology talent, talent retention, long-term business needs, and how its teams work across locations. The hub will become part of the broader Technology organization, not a standalone team. Recruiting is expected to begin in Q1, with more details to come as plans are finalized.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用真实公告中的 Chennai 和选址因素作答，再说明组织归属与招聘计划；招聘日期仍以公司后续公布为准。

words.example: The new schedule is designed to improve staff retention.
words.translation: 新的排班安排旨在提高员工留任率。

words.example: Opening the regional office is an important milestone for the team.
words.translation: 开设区域办公室是团队的一项重要进展。

words.example: We’ll finalize the hiring plan after the budget review.
words.translation: 预算审核后我们会敲定招聘计划。

structure.original: The selection of Chennai was informed by several factors, including access to a deep pool of technology talent, a reputation for strong talent retention, the ability to support our long-term business needs and alignment with the ways our teams work across Seattle, Nashville, London and Hong Kong.
